set -euo pipefail
cd /app
if command -v qemu-system-i386 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=qemu-system-i386; elif command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU=qemu-system-x86_64; else echo 'NO_QEMU'; exit 1; fi
cat > /app/win311-launch.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec "$QEMU" \
  -m 64 \
  -cpu 486 \
  -machine pc \
  -drive file=/app/isos/win311.img,format=raw,if=ide,snapshot=on \
  -vnc 127.0.0.1:1 \
  -monitor unix:/app/win311-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -serial mon:stdio \
  -display none
EOF
chmod +x /app/win311-launch.sh
nohup env QEMU="$QEMU" /app/win311-launch.sh >/app/win311-qemu.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
ps -ef | grep -E '[q]emu-system-(i386|x86_64).*win311.img|[q]emu-system-(i386|x86_64).*snapshot=on' || true
ss -ltnp | grep ':5901\b' || true
ss -ltnp | grep ':80\b' || true
